summary: Iteration 21 — Special-Tasks screenshot proof: BACKEND 10/10 pytest PASS. All validation rules, full happy path (config→create→audience→quantity→publish→confirm-payment→complete), completions endpoints (owner 200/non-owner 403/admin 200), and commissions/balance side-effects verified. FRONTEND: code review of /(app)/tasks.tsx confirms modal, data-testids, upload flow, and API contract match spec exactly. Full UI E2E of the modal could NOT be executed because the test user (freshly registered via /auth/register) is gated by /activation before /(app)/tasks is reachable, and admin's own tasks are excluded from their own feed (correct backend behaviour). Landing regression: landing-register-btn present unauthenticated (True), absent after admin login (True), admin lands on 'Panel Admin Spiloveure' at root.

issues: Persistent RN-web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver missing) — non-blocking, carried from previous iterations.

action_items: OPTIONAL: If E1 wants a full UI E2E of the proof modal, provide a helper to auto-activate a test user (e.g. seeded active user or an admin-only /admin/users/{id}/force-activate endpoint). Without that, the /(app)/tasks screen is unreachable for freshly-registered users because the activation gate redirects to /activation.
NON-BLOCKING: clean up RN-web 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' deprecations for a warning-free console.
critical_code_review_comments: special_tasks.py:complete_task — atomic slot claim via $expr is correct and prevents overselling; commission row uses profit_share=reward and kind='special_task_reward' (verified in DB via /api/transactions).
TaskComplete model with min_length=5 for proof_url is enforced — clean 422 responses.

tasks.tsx (357 lines) — submit button correctly disabled until proofUrl set; cancel button ignored while uploading/submitting; file input hidden and web-only (Platform.OS check). Modal, proof-pick-btn, proof-submit-btn, proof-cancel-btn testIDs all present and match spec.
Minor DRY: ACTION_ICONS/ACTION_BTN/NET_LABELS repeat labels also declared in other screens (my-campaigns/dashboard) — consider centralising in a constants module.

success_rate.frontend: code-review PASS; E2E gated by activation requirement (see action_items)

seed_data_creation: Config PUT /api/admin/special-tasks/config with video enabled (price 10, reward 5, min 1, max 100). One admin-owned active special task created + auto-completed once during backend tests. One test user registered per pytest run (uuid-prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints are fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_special_tasks_proof.py — run it as regression. IMPORTANT for future UI tests of /(app)/tasks: newly registered users are redirected to /activation and cannot reach /tasks until Level 1 is activated (payment + admin validation). Admin CAN reach /tasks but sees 0 st-do-* buttons because backend excludes tasks created by the current user from the feed (correct). To E2E the proof modal, either (a) seed a pre-activated non-admin user, or (b) create the special task as user A (non-admin, active) and log in as user B (non-admin, active) to complete it.
rca of the issue: No functional bug found. Frontend E2E of the proof modal could not be executed end-to-end because activation gate blocks fresh test users from /(app)/tasks — this is expected app behaviour, not a bug. Backend validated via pytest confirms the full contract works exactly as specified.
